_about: Review-tool outputs captured by running Annealage Mesh at commit 406b074 (before the review model moved into annealage-agent): tool metadata, results as the model reads them, and the callouts file as written. {serve_dir} stands for the served directory. tests/test_review_contract.py replays the same calls against the current code and requires these exactly.

list_comments.description: Read the human's submitted pin comments on the 3D model: each one's number, the part and face it is on, its point in model coordinates, and what they wrote. This is the feedback to act on. A pin the human has placed but not yet submitted is not here yet.

list_callouts.description: Read the callouts currently pinned on the 3D model, the cyan markers the human sees, including any you added earlier and any a previous session left. Use it before add_callout to avoid repeating a note, and to find the id delete_callout takes.

add_callout.description: Pin a note of your own at a point on the 3D model, which appears to the human as a numbered cyan marker in the viewer and a row in the review panel. This is how to point at a location instead of describing it: put the callout on the feature you are asking about or reporting on, and say what you mean in the comment.

point.description: where the marker goes, [x, y, z] in model coordinates, the same space as a pin's point

comment.description: what you are saying about that point

part.description: which part it is on, for the panel's label; a rel or a label from list_models

label.description: the face direction, e.g. "+Z", if it helps

delete_callout.description: Remove one of the callouts pinned on the 3D model by its id, so a note you have finished with stops cluttering the viewer. Use list_callouts to see the ids.

list_comments_absent.text: the human has not submitted any pin comments yet (mesh-comments.json does not exist, or holds no annotations)
